verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client, so offline reading, searching, and composing with sync on reconnect is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any offline mode, local mail cache, offline search, or queued sync. Local attachment downloads and a 'snappy desktop app' are adjacent features, not offline capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
